summary_bullets: Add a per-Claude-PID /design launcher so post-setup Bash fences share one transport contract.
Collapse /design fences and references to launcher form while preserving explicit Step 0a setup.
Strengthen unit, structure, and pause/resume coverage for launcher creation, dispatch, and invalid routing.
commit_message:
Collapse design fences behind session launcher

Add the per-PID /design launcher emitted by write-design-env, require a valid plugin root for launcher-backed sessions, and fail closed when launcher creation is unsafe. Collapse post-Step-0a /design fences and references to the launcher form while keeping Step 0a explicit. Extend session, structure, and pause/resume coverage for the new contract.
